assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. ONE 3 columns by 3 rows atlas of nine independent picture-question assets for Chinese grade one science. Fine paper grain, matte gouache, clean cut-paper edges, warm cream with pine green, pale teal and small persimmon accents. Perfectly straight equal cream gutters at the thirds, separate crop-safe scenes filling their cell with 12% inside margins. No text, numbers, labels, directional arrows, checks, crosses as marks, decorative clutter or overlapping panels. Row 1 column 1: shallow coral tray with EXACTLY THREE separate white crumpled paper balls and one empty open sage box beside it, clearly visible, no tool. Row 1 column 2: strictly overhead view of a small orange wooden clothespin lying over the near edge of a pale blue paper rectangle; its opaque upper jaw covers the actual contact between paper and jaw, only top surfaces visible. Row 1 column 3: low close side profile of the EXACT same orange wooden clothespin at the same spot on the same blue paper, with visibly two jaws and the edge of blue paper visibly between and touched by both jaws. Row 2 column 1: rear view of the SAME orange clothespin holding the SAME blue rectangle, camera directly behind the spring/tail so the clamping tips and their contact with paper are hidden. Row 2 column 2: two simple side-by-side mini-pictures divided by a hairline inside this cell, same small green cardboard drawer and same hand tugging straight out in both panels; left drawing shows the hand pinching the flat front lip with no handle, right drawing shows the hand holding a new rounded orange ribbon pull attached to the same drawer. Row 2 column 3: paired mini-pictures of a yellow deep drawer with an orange pull beside a clearly different flat blue drawer with an orange pull, a hand tugging each. Row 3 column 1: two paired mini-pictures of the same small green drawer with equally sized orange and blue ribbon pulls, no hands, both closed; only ribbon color differs. Row 3 column 2: same yellow paper snack bag and same short green wooden clothespin side by side in two mini-pictures, left clip attached exactly at the left end of folded mouth, right clip attached exactly at the center of folded mouth. Row 3 column 3: two clearly different bags side by side, yellow paper bag with small green wooden clothespin at center of mouth, and larger blue paper bag with large red metal binder clip at center. Keep small pictures very clear and separate.
